title: Medical exam for a certificate
what: A checkup with several doctors, and tests if needed, to get a medical certificate for a driving license, work, or school.
why: To get or renew a driving license, when starting a new job, regularly for some jobs, and for school and sports.
duration: usually 1 to 3 hours, sometimes over several days
tell_doctor: What the certificate is for, and which license category
What medicines you take. Some can affect test results
If you wear glasses, contact lenses, or a hearing aid

prepare.title: List of doctors
prepare.text: Ask the clinic in advance which doctors and tests you need. It depends on the type of certificate and the country.

prepare.title: Referral
prepare.text: For work, you usually need a referral from your employer.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: Get a good night's sleep. No alcohol for 2 to 3 days. If you need blood tests, ask whether to come fasting.

bring: A referral from your employer, if it is for work
Your glasses or contact lenses, if you wear them
A photo, if the clinic asks for one
Your old certificate or health record, if you have one
steps: You check in and get a list of rooms to visit
You usually see a general doctor and an eye doctor
For a driving certificate, also a psychiatrist and an addiction specialist. Sometimes an alcohol and drug test is needed
For some license categories and jobs, also an EEG, an ear, nose, and throat doctor, a neurologist, and others
Sometimes you have tests, an ECG, or a chest X-ray
At the end, you get a certificate or a report
feel: Nothing unpleasant. Just normal checkups and questions
after: The certificate is often given the same day, if no test results are pending
If a doctor is unsure, they may send you for more tests
Check your full name, the date, and the stamps on the certificate

faq.q: Which doctors do I need for a driving certificate?
faq.a: Usually a general doctor, an eye doctor, a psychiatrist, and an addiction specialist. For some categories, also an EEG and other doctors. Check the exact list with your clinic.

faq.q: Can I do the exam wearing glasses?
faq.a: Yes, if you drive in them. The certificate will then say you must drive with glasses or lenses.

faq.q: What if I do not get the certificate?
faq.a: Usually the doctor sends you for more tests. After that, the certificate is often given.

reminders.text: Medical exam for a certificate in 2 days. No alcohol until the exam. Check your documents, glasses, and referral.
